sources.title: Ninon, lach mir einmal zu — Odeon O-4661, catalogue and matrix evidence
sources.creator: Jan Kiepura
sources.researchNote: The directly consulted DNB record identifies Kiepura, orchestral direction by Dr. Weissmann, Odeon O-4661 and matrix Be.10221-4. Its linked “Oh Madonna!” side is a separate entry with matrix Be.10220-2. The previously cited GHT matrix discography supplies Be 10221 and the Berlin session date 7 February 1933; its full PDF could not be consulted during this review. The structured date describes that reported session, not a DNB issue date. The session has not been independently matched to the -4 take catalogued by DNB, or to the separate YouTube transfer.
